snippet.title: Apolune 2 Game Play - Sliced Plus Uncut Hour
snippet.description: Apolune 2 is a 1 to 8 player arcade shooter with survival elements where you and your friends cooperate to manage a space station while mining asteroids, fighting aliens and strategically trading to earn funds for Ore Corp.  If you earn enough money you can buy properties like a pub or hotel that increase your odds of survival greatly and pump your income.
